findings.contract: Carry each physical or dimensionless quantity from the actual recipe/default/serde/UI producer through retained state to its native numerical/framework boundary.
evidence: material.rs:22-38,75-119: scratch count/shape/angles/u32 seed/waviness/grain/smudge remain raw; scratch_length is fraction of tile, scratch_width is floating texel span, waviness metres.
construction.rs:29-59,195-280: Plate dimensions and Lacing.radius are metre scalars, hole_pairs is a physical pair population, ratios are independent unitless fractions.
engraving.rs:25-33,66-86: depth metres; strength/repeats-per-tile/recess offset ratios; rotation radians. ornament.rs:13-44: repeated figures, strands, ratios and fillet role.
trim/finish.rs:16-94 and trim.rs:32-46: authored width/physical band/period/nearest-rim coordinates are raw lengths; DepthMap.uv_scale in material/textures.rs:24 is a UV ratio.
garment_material.rs:31-42,72-99: diameters/pitch metres, tilt degrees, repeat two-axis metres, density rings per square metre.
findings.connected_repair: Choose the exact leaves, type every retained recipe field and semantic return together, adapt defaults and existing literals, carry through cut/image/sampling/trim/construction/mail chart, then convert only at egui/image/Bevy/WGSL/numerical kernels. Also migrate Metal::TILES_PER_METRE and dimensional bounds; never fix only PassParameters insertion sites.
dependencies: Math units::Metres/Ratio/PerMetre already imported by Armor and Creator; Geometry positive/signed finite leaves have different acceptance policies.
Plain radians/degrees, floating texel span, exact32 LCG seed and physical scratch/repeat/strand populations need an explicit canonical owner decision; MP-2.
findings.acceptance: No raw equivalent is retained between domain APIs; accepted recipe bounds and valid zeros remain identical; field getters terminate at documented arithmetic/serde/framework/native operations, not another application wrapper.

findings.contract: Unit, role, numeric policy and representation all have to fit before reusing an owner.
evidence: math/units.rs:14-38,52-100 provides unbounded Metres, Ratio and PerMetre; no bare Radians or Degrees.

geometry/length.rs:16-39 rejects zero/nonfinite/negative; measurement.rs:21-65 SignedLength rejects nonfinite. These cannot replace zero-valid depth/waviness/gap or unvalidated authored holders indiscriminately.
determinism/seed.rs:54-94 is u64 record serde and eight-byte input; stream.rs uses SplitMix64, whereas gpu/metal/wgsl.rs:39-84 defines wrapping u32 LCG and top24 draw.

building-generator/spatial_geometry/orientation.rs Radians is a finite generator geometry owner with higher-layer errors, not an importable low-level Armor leaf. Armor design.rs Milliradians is nonnegative quantized u16.
mesh/count.rs describes native topology; gpu buffer/stride.rs describes native storage; pass/shape.rs and grid.rs describe launches. None describes authored scratch population or RNG draw offset.
textile_pattern.rs:52-58 TextileRepeatCount is u8 textile-chart repetition with per-use bounds; TextileThreadCount is yarn population. Neither owns metal engraving geometry.
findings.connected_repair: Reuse unit-only Metres/Ratio/PerMetre where exact; name a coherent common angular leaf at the lowest shared layer if moving/reusing the finite angle owner, or document a distinct unbounded-unit contract. Keep exact32 finish seed/LCG role distinct from world/root Seed without a widening/narrowing adapter or alternative RNG. Use purpose populations, not storage/launch wrappers, for authored scratch/repeat/strand counts.
dependencies: A finite-angle owner move would affect existing generator callers and Geometry error/reflection policy; do not copy the same checked owner into Armor.

A new shared deterministic32 leaf changes dependency edges if placed in determinism; both workspace lockfiles then need the exact Armor dependency edge. Local metal-specific native seed is a distinct role, not a duplicate 64-bit root.
No generic inverse-area/rings-per-square-metre owner was found in the inspected lowest owners; do not reuse PerMetre.
findings.acceptance: All accepted u32 seeds preserve exact bits and current JSON scalar; all existing native coefficients and LCG draws are unchanged; invalid angular/physical policy is not strengthened accidentally.

findings.contract: The source variant owns the relief payload combinations that can actually execute.
evidence: engraving.rs:25-28 independently stores ReliefSource and Relief; validate:110-132 rejects Ornament+Normal; Cut::new validates again before any native execution.
metal_controls.rs:122-175 changes source and relief together only when selecting Pattern; Image can select Height/Normal. Inactive data transitions have current explicit policy.
ornament.rs:20 fillets is a semantic carried choice; words:91-99 encodes the motif as positional (code,first,second,strands), and gpu/metal/ornament.rs duplicates code0..5 in WGSL.

tiling/lacing.rs:31-36 already owns Lamellar/Scale Style. Cord.closed and through(leaving:bool) carry closure and travel direction; ordinary comparison predicates and shader u32 flags are boundary facts.
findings.connected_repair: Select a final payload enum such as image(path+image relief) versus ornament(motif+height depth), retain common sampling fields once, propagate constructors/serde/UI/Cut/errors/native projection. Replace semantic fillet and carried cord-direction/closure booleans with named roles at their proper shared owner; keep true predicates and native flags at adapters. Replace Motif::words positional tuple with one named native projection derived from the actual motif, and give Rust/native codes one authority.
dependencies: Do not reuse TextilePathClosure blindly for plate cords: its owner includes textile stroke semantics. A shared curve-closure move has its own callers.

Engraving existing bounds fixture deliberately constructs Ornament+Normal. Plan direct existing-case API adaptation before changing representation; no new test, case, helper or assertion and no deleting its semantic obligation.
Any GPU generator facade/signature change needs exact #826 agreement; protected MetalGpu methods can remain unchanged.
findings.acceptance: Unsupported Ornament+Normal remains impossible/rejected rather than silently enabled; every currently valid source has identical decoding and native output; motif code0..5/payload/order, neutral lanes and fillet behavior are preserved.

library_name.rs:12-20 TryFrom returns String; decoration_controls.rs:16 and wardrobe_tab.rs:24 wrap it using Error::msg.
garment/selection.rs:207-225 wraps coif failure into formatted Debug prose, unlike the typed Context path for sewing pattern; MP broader cause frontier remains incomplete.
outfit.rs:17-21 turns typed loadout conflict into presentation text inside anyhow. Final studio_ui output correctly formats at UI, but the cause has already been erased.
findings.connected_repair: Introduce or reuse typed authoritative validation errors at MailWeave/LibraryName/Recipe/Inventory/Article as needed, retaining item/name/version/count context and sources. Keep actual lower design/engraving/construction sources via from/source/context; remove internal format-to-String and Error::msg barriers through generation/main/load/save and library receivers. Keep presentation at final UI/CLI/warning boundaries.
dependencies: Preserve exact first-error order: recipe version, coefficient counts, name, nonfinite coefficients, inventory order/duplicate IDs then article validation order; Catalog design then decoration then construction, Garment resolution then construction then drape then mail.
Actual ItemDesign and ParametricDesign validators mostly already preserve typed errors via Error::new/Context; do not replace them with broad new message adapters.
Fresh broader pattern/stage/equipment_catalog/occupancy/body-proportion validation source remains explicitly unread, so this report does not certify whole application causal closure.
findings.acceptance: Actual source chains expose original typed material/IO/image/native/geometry causes after recipe and library handling; unchanged finite/range checks and first failure survive. Only UI/CLI text changes presentation, not control flow or unsupported acceptance.

Do not change process OnceCell success/failure caching or native retry semantics; that policy is already explicitly owned separately.
findings.acceptance: All three actual caller paths handle causes at final UI; no production expect, no partial asset/cache/applied publication for failed replacement, identical successful materials and PNG bytes.

findings.contract: Editing ring appearance must not invalidate cloth simulation, while true layer/order/body/lining/drape inputs still do.
evidence: garment_material.rs module docs and garment/selection.rs:122-126 explicitly call mail appearance-only; same_simulation:199-205 compares construction,fabric,resolution,drape and excludes mail.
inventory_article_editor.rs draped return uses same_simulation/layer, so mail edit intentionally does not set dirty; drape_preview::refresh_mail updates only materials.
studio_cache.rs:148-162 drape_changed serializes full piece.selection, therefore includes mail; studio_generation.rs:117-121 invokes it on next regeneration and requests a drape if changed.
outfit.rs:53-79 computes under-plate standoff/order from loadout, fabric, channel and lining; these genuine dependencies cannot be dropped just because same_simulation omits layer.
findings.connected_repair: Let GarmentSelection own an explicit simulation-input projection shared with same_simulation/cache identity; retain actual independent routing layer/order/settled drape/body/lining dependencies once. Exclude MailWeave appearance from that simulation key and retain live name/appearance updates without recomputing dynamics.
dependencies: The actual cache/worker checkpoint source must be read before selecting final key; garment/stages.rs and drape worker internals are not freshly complete here.
Do not use a fresh hand-copied list in StudioCache that can drift from same_simulation.
findings.acceptance: A mail edit followed by an unrelated regeneration does not re-run cloth stages; construction/fabric/resolution/drape and actual layer/order/lining changes still request the appropriate existing simulation.

findings.contract: Construction and trim operate on agreeing finite, index-valid columns; physical recipe admission alone proves no mesh shape.
evidence: design.rs:134-160 exposes all GeneratedArmor columns publicly; surface_grid.rs:9-17 rows/columns/vertices are independently public.
tiling/mod.rs:53-77 validates Construction then GridSurface::is_spanning; surface.rs:115-131 only checks rows/columns/product and directly indexes positions by grid IDs.
Representable counterexample: a valid Scale(Tiling::scale()), a public regular(2,2,false,vec![0;4]) grid, and empty position/normal columns passes is_spanning then positions[0] panics.

trim.rs:88-99 checks nonempty faces and triple count, then Rims::new. Empty positions plus indices [0,0,0] and [PlateFace::Outer] passes that count condition then trim/edges.rs plates/rim_edges indexes welded[0].
trim/split.rs:42-75,210-252 indexes normals/UV/skin/morph/component ranges without a complete source-column admission; tiling/embedded.rs:62-104 similarly consumes skin and morph columns.
findings.connected_repair: Add operation-local borrowed admitted geometry views or consume an existing canonical checked source, checking only used columns, complete triples, finite native coordinates and all referenced IDs/component/morph extents before indexing or mutation. Propagate actual typed causes through Constructed/Trim error owners and callers; no global geometry algorithm rewrite.
dependencies: Separate connected family from already inventoried GLB/export admission UV-R1/R2; validating an exporter does not repair these earlier public CPU consumers.

Native GeneratedArmor producers and shared SurfaceGrid construction/recording functions remain a dependency requiring exact ownership/caller inventory before repair. This report has not freshly read all producer paths.
findings.acceptance: Malformed representable input returns an owned typed error before indexing/partial mutation; valid construction/trim topology, UVs, morph order and native bytes remain identical; no new recipe ceiling.

findings.contract: The advertised plate budget and native index limits must be checked before row/column growth or narrowing.
evidence: tiling/mod.rs:29 MAX_TILES=20,000; layout.rs:83-87 checks layout.tiles.len only after lay_grid returns.
layout.rs:113-129 converts ceil row population to usize then adds1 and allocates grid_rows; columns:220-250 collects physical columns before checking remaining budget.

Representable finite well-shaped planar 2x2 surface with height1e18m and width1m has finite frame/cross arithmetic but row quotient exceeds 64-bit usize for default Scale pitch; cast saturates then +1 overflows before TooManyPlates. The 32-bit path fails sooner.
tiling/mod.rs:102 and tiling/lacing.rs:253,298 cast grown vertex populations to u32; template and trim/split also narrow without a shared admitted full mesh extent.
findings.connected_repair: Admit physical row/column/tile/cord populations with checked host arithmetic and remaining actual MAX_TILES budget before allocation/growth; use canonical MeshVertexCount/MeshTriangleCount/MeshCornerCount for native topology boundaries and reserve causes where actual allocation is fallible. Never substitute InvocationCount/BufferElementCount/sorting lengths for those physical quantities.
dependencies: Exact existing small-plate budget is already policy; this is enforcing it, not authorizing a stricter geometry extent cap.
Full finite-geometry and native producer frontier must be inventoried before implementing count/shape changes; no speculative altered tiling algorithm.
findings.acceptance: Oversized construction returns TooManyPlates or an exact representability/reservation cause before growth; accepted small geometry and every existing face/index order stay unchanged.

Metal UI and motif shape sliders duplicate policy ranges already owned by validators; current exact ranges match, but shared typed bounds should become the authority rather than retaining competing literals.

Retained library paths in Decorations/WardrobeLibrary are String, while actual IO expects Path; source path inputs in Args are PathBuf and Engraving already uses PathBuf. UI TextEdit raw text is a true boundary.

Expose named typed bounds from semantic owners to UI. Carry canonical filesystem path owners through internal state; raw edit buffers and display strings stay at egui/IO formatting.
dependencies: Do not change default material recipes via generic Default derivation: Metal/Lacing/Trim/Mail/Ornament defaults are authored construction data.

findings.acceptance: Wire strings and trim-whitespace behavior are identical, no string classification drives material roles, all derive bounds/Formatter behavior remain equivalent; policy ranges have one semantic owner.
